findings.title: A title that looks like an id shadows the id lookup
findings.why: `find` tries the key as a title first, then as an id. Ids are generated as `task-N` and titles are free text, so a task titled `task-2` makes `complete('task-2')`, `rename('task-2', ...)` and `remove('task-2')` act on that task instead of the task whose id is `task-2`. `get('task-2')` still returns the other task, so `find` and `get` disagree. Nothing rejects or reserves such titles.

findings.title: Doc comment on TaskList is one overlong line
